solutionSql:
SELECT s.customer_id, i.id,
       SUM(i.amount) OVER (
         PARTITION BY s.customer_id
         ORDER BY i.issued_at, i.id
         ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
       ) AS running_total
FROM invoices i
JOIN shipments s ON s.id = i.shipment_id
ORDER BY s.customer_id, i.issued_at, i.id;
notes: SUM window with ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING ordered by (issued_at, id). A correlated-subquery formulation agrees on all 205 rows.
